title: Security Group Ingress Audit
description: Reports every security group with an ingress rule open to 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0, which ports it exposes, and whether the group is attached to anything. Read-only: it revokes no rule.

inputs.label: AWS region
inputs.help: One region per run. Bucket and IAM listings are account-wide; EC2 resources are per-region.

nodes.label: Audit security group ingress

requires.customerText: An AWS cloud integration available to this project, with read-only permission for: ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups, ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
The job runner executes Python steps; boto3 ships in the image.
